In `scripts/player.gd` I added a "Reset Health" Inspector button using `@export_tool_button`, which calls a new `reset_health()` that sets `health` to `max_health` and emits `health_changed`. I couldn't run Godot, so none of this has been tested.

The button only works in the editor if the script is a tool script, so I added `@tool`. To keep the game behaving as before, `_physics_process` now returns early when `Engine.is_editor_hint()` is true, so the player doesn't move in the editor.
